label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 14: Obligations of the consumer in the event of withdrawal
5. Except as provided for in Article 13(2) and in this Article, the consumer shall not incur any liability as a consequence of the exercise of the right of withdrawal.
raw_output: When a customer cancels an order after receiving goods, the business cannot charge them for any costs related to the cancellation. This applies when the customer exercises their right to withdraw from a contract.
enrichment: When a customer cancels an order after receiving goods, the business cannot charge them for any costs related to the cancellation. This applies when the customer exercises their right to withdraw from a contract.
